title: Grateful Dead Live at Unknown Venue on 1970-05-24

ai_review.summary: Rough‑but‑lively soundboard capture of the Dead’s first European gig, highlighted by a breathtaking Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is an old‑school soundboard tape that suffers from some roughness and occasional technical hiccups, yet listeners repeatedly note the superb “attic” placement and the historic value of hearing Garcia on his Gibson SG. The show itself is praised as high‑energy, festival‑style fun with a standout Dark Star that many fans remember as one of the early European highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the performance highly (4‑5 stars) and describe it as a great, historic show; recording quality is mixed but still listenable, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rough, middle‑of‑the‑road tape with occasional technical problems, but the attic mic placement is praised for its clarity and depth; overall listenable despite vintage limitations.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festival‑type set that opened at sunset and ran into night, delivering high energy and a historic first European appearance for the band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is highlighted – his Dark Star variant is described as breathtaking and reviewers note this may be the first tape of him back on a Gibson SG.
